label: Causal propagation of brute contingency under fixed governing laws
summary: The same contingent, uncaused founder without any #312 existence reason is modeled under three population boundaries. Conservation of persistent individuals excludes late entry. Capacity one permits the same late candidate in the founder’s absence yet excludes it alongside the founder. Unrestricted birth inputs admit an additional uncaused agent at every specified later tick, preserving prior presences and changing one detector. This defeats the bare shared-premise inference without adjudicating which boundary is metaphysically necessary. Paired interventions on a connected three-site path give every pair assignment and preserve total parity; one optional unmatched endpoint flip gives all triples. In a fixed XOR evidence channel the truth of a measured change survives precisely when its two offsets agree. The subject note compares closure of a calibrated inventory, dispositional, best-system, necessitarian and classical-theistic restrictions, the same-agent strict-norm conflict, matched standards of explanatory adequacy, and the existing B2/C2 routes. #1874’s independent infinite-closure obligation remains. One can exclude a specified change on a retained target by accounting exhaustively for its ways of receiving influence, even if the source inventory stays open. A violation can reveal an unmodeled coupling while leaving its bearer’s existential origin open. All three formal results passed binding, Comparator and NanoDa. The existing c056ad5c excludes two actual concrete roots of the same grounding relation at a selected world under its other-cause, identity-uniqueness and application premises. It needs no necessary founder. Transport to retained-founder continuations and replacement of local absence of production by actual grounding-root status are separate application obligations.
blocker: The repeatable new-agent insertion route needs warrant for an unreceived onset and joint composition of its origins and exercises at the fixed background. One effective eligible addition defeats a universal ban. Other mechanisms, including separately admitted rich initial inputs, can produce arbitrary joint outputs without late entry. Crossing the particular parity boundary requires some effective change that breaks its invariant. Universal exclusion of entrants requires essential exhaustive closure or universal receipt of existence. Actual epistemic defeat needs evidence about exposure of reliable channels and the inquirer’s own entitlement standard.
